results.note: Coronatio Caroli II is a medieval Carolingian coronation ordo; searched extensively and found no English translation of this specific text.

Coronatio Hermintrudis reginae (coronation of Queen Hermintrudis, 866) is a medieval coronation rite; no English translation found despite searches for both the specific title and general queen-making ordines.
Coronatio Ludovici II is a Carolingian coronation text; no English translation located in academic or digital collections.
De fundatione monasterii S. Arnulfi Metensis (foundation history of St. Arnold of Metz monastery) found referenced in medieval sources but no English translation identified.
De gestis episcoporum Antissiodorensium (9th century episcopal history of Auxerre) referenced on Documenta Catholica Omnia in Latin only; no English translation found.
De prandio monachorum (monastic meal customs/liturgy) is a specialized medieval ecclesiastical text with no identified English translation.
De successoribus S. Hidulphi in Vosago (on successors of St. Hidulph in the Vosges) found only in Latin sources; no English translation identified.
Electio Ludovici Arelatensis (election/elevation of Louis of Arles) is a medieval diplomatic/liturgical text; no English translation found.
Electio regis Bosonis (election of King Boso) is a medieval election ordo; searched for both specific title and general medieval king election texts—no English translation found.
Electio regis Odonis (election of King Odo) is a medieval diplomatic text with no identified English translation.
Electio regis Widonis (election of King Wido/Guy) is a medieval election text; no English translation located.
Epistola canonica (canonical letter) is a specialized medieval ecclesiastical text with no identified English translation.
Expositio super missam (explanation/exposition of the Mass) is a medieval liturgical commentary; while such texts exist (e.g., by Hugh of Saint Victor), no translation of this specific work found.

Fragmenta liturgiae Gallicanae (fragments of Gallican liturgy) are specialized liturgical materials; searched for Gallican liturgy translations but found no complete English translation of these fragments.
Fragmentum Kalendarii Lucensis (calendar fragment from Lucca) is a liturgical calendar fragment with no identified English translation.
Fragmentum Kalendarii Vallumbrosani (Vallombrosan calendar fragment) is a specialized liturgical calendar text; no English translation found.
Fragmentum Missae Latinae (Latin Mass fragment) is a fragmentary liturgical text with no identified English translation.
Fragmentum Statutorum Canonicorum Turonensium (statute fragment from Tours canons) is a specialized canonical/liturgical text; no English translation located.
Judicium poenitentis (judgment/examination of the penitent) is a medieval penitential text; extensive searches found no published English translation.
Kalendarium Brixianum (Brescia calendar) is a liturgical calendar with no identified English translation.
Kalendarium Floriacense (Fleury calendar) is a specialized liturgical calendar; no English translation found.
Kalendarium Mantuanum (Mantua calendar) is a medieval liturgical calendar text with no identified English translation.
Kalendarium Vallumbrosanum (Vallombrosan calendar) is a Benedictine liturgical calendar; no English translation located.
Kalendarium Verdinense (Verdun calendar) is a liturgical calendar from Verdun; no English translation identified.
Kalendarium antiquissimum (most ancient calendar) is an early medieval liturgical calendar with no identified English translation.
Litaniae Arelatenses (litany of Arles) is a medieval liturgical litany; no English translation found despite searches for litany translations.
Litaniae Byzuntinae (Byzantine litany) is a specialized liturgical litany; no English translation located.
Litaniae Carolinae (Carolingian/Charlemagne litany) is a medieval liturgical text; searches yielded no published English translation.
Litaniae constitutae a S. patribus (litanies established by the holy fathers) is a medieval liturgical litany with no identified English translation.

Martyrologium Bedae has an English translation in K. Karasawa, The Old English Metrical Calendar (Menologium) (Cambridge: D.S. Brewer, 2005), appendix 2, pp. 138-145; also published on Roger Pearse's website.
Martyrologium ecclesiae Antissiodorensis (martyrology of Auxerre cathedral) is a specialized liturgical calendar/martyrology; no English translation identified.
Missa Aethiopum (Ethiopian Mass/liturgy) is a medieval liturgical text with no identified complete English translation, though mentioned in liturgical scholarship.
Missa Latina (Latin Mass) is a generic liturgical text title; no specific English translation of this work identified, though general medieval mass translations exist.

Missae Gallicanae XI (Gallican Masses) may be included in Matthew Cheung Salisbury's Medieval Latin Liturgy in English Translation (2017), which covers medieval liturgical masses, but this cannot be confirmed without access to the complete table of contents.
Necrologium Gerundense (death roll/necrology of Gerona) is a specialized medieval monastic text; no English translation identified.
Obsequium circa morientes (services for the dying) is a medieval liturgical/pastoral text; no English translation located.
Orationes contra Daemoniacum (prayers against the demoniac) is a specialized liturgical/exorcism text; no published English translation found.
Orationes (prayers) is a generic title for medieval liturgical prayers; no specific English translation of this work identified.
Ordo ad regem benedicendum (order for blessing the king) is a medieval coronation/royal blessing ordo; found on Documenta Catholica Omnia in Latin only with no English translation.
Ordo ad visitandum infirmum (order for visiting the sick) is a medieval pastoral/liturgical ordo; no English translation identified despite searches.

Ordo baptismatis (baptismal order) is a medieval baptismal ordo; while general medieval baptismal texts have translations (e.g., Ordo Baptismi Adultorum), this specific work's translation status is unclear.
Ordo baptismi secundum usum Aethiopum (Ethiopian baptismal order) is a specialized liturgical text; no complete English translation found despite searches.

Ordo de dedicatione ecclesiae (order for church dedication) is a medieval church dedication ordo; while modern post-Vatican II ordinations have English versions, no medieval English translation of this specific ordo identified.
Ordo de sacris ordinibus (order of sacred orders/ordinations) is a medieval ordination ordo; no English translation found in searches of academic databases and liturgical resources.
Ordo excommunicationis (order of excommunication) is a medieval ecclesiastical discipline text; no English translation identified.
